description: This file contains utility functions for handling ZIP archives, including safe extraction with ZipSlip prevention, creating ZIP archives from directories or file sets, and listing ZIP contents.

methods.name: bool _is_within_directory(directory: Path, target: Path)
methods.description: Checks if a target path is within a specified directory to prevent ZipSlip vulnerabilities.

methods.name: None safe_extract_zip(zip_path: Path, dest_dir: Path, *, allow_symlinks: bool = False)
methods.description: Safely extracts a ZIP file into a specified directory, preventing path traversal and optionally blocking symlinks.

methods.name: None create_zip_from_directory(source_dir: Path, zip_path: Path, include_patterns: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None)
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive from a directory, optionally filtering files by include patterns.

methods.name: None create_zip_from_files(files: Iterable[Path], base_dir: Path, zip_path: Path)
methods.description: Creates a ZIP archive from specific files, preserving paths relative to a base directory.

methods.name: list[str] read_zip_filenames(zip_path: Path)
methods.description: Returns a list of filenames contained in a ZIP archive.

ctags.name: create_zip_from_directory
ctags.pattern: /^def create_zip_from_directory(source_dir: Path, zip_path: Path, include_patterns: Optional[Itera/
ctags.signature: (source_dir: Path, zip_path: Path, include_patterns: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None)

ctags.name: create_zip_from_files
ctags.pattern: /^def create_zip_from_files(files: Iterable[Path], base_dir: Path, zip_path: Path) -> None:$/

ctags.name: safe_extract_zip
ctags.pattern: /^def safe_extract_zip(zip_path: Path, dest_dir: Path, *, allow_symlinks: bool = False) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (zip_path: Path, dest_dir: Path, *, allow_symlinks: bool = False)
